claims: Jon Scheyer is the head men's basketball coach at Duke University.
Jon Scheyer took over for Mike Krzyzewski in 2022.
Jon Scheyer was named the 20th head coach in Duke program history on June 4, 2021.
Jon Scheyer is a former Duke All-American player.
Jon Scheyer was a team captain at Duke.
Jon Scheyer served on Mike Krzyzewski’s staff starting in 2013-14.
Jon Scheyer held roles as assistant and associate head coach on Mike Krzyzewski’s staff.
Jon Scheyer led Duke to three ACC titles in his first four seasons.
Jon Scheyer has a winning percentage of 83.7% as of March 2026.
Jon Scheyer signed a contract extension in October 2023.
Jon Scheyer's contract extension runs through the 2028-29 season.
Mike Krzyzewski retired following the 2021-22 season.
Mike Krzyzewski coached 42 seasons at Duke.
Mike Krzyzewski won five national championships.
